paite: Huan siampu a pang a, ka na sem ding a na siansakna dia hiai ahi atung ua na hih ding, bawngtalnou khat leh belampa nih gensiatbei na la ding ahi.
heading: Siampu Ding A Aaron Leh Atapate Sehdan Ding / (Lev 8.1-36)
english: “This is the thing that you shall do to them to make them holy, to minister to me in the priest’s office: take one young bull and two rams without defect,

paite: Huai ban ah tanghou silngou soh louh, tanghou beu silngou soh louh thau a zut leh tanghou pek silngou soh louh thau a zut, huit buh tangbuang in na bawl ding ahi.
english: unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You shall make them of fine wheat flour.

paite: Huaite loh sung ah na koih dia, bawngtal leh belampa nihte toh, loh in na hon tawi ding hi.
english: You shall put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bull and the two rams.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Aaron leh atapate na hon pi dia, tui in amau na sil ding ahi.
english: You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

paite: Huai khit in siampu puansilhte na la dia, puanak tung leh siampu puanaktual leh siampu puan leh awmtuam Aaron na silhsak dia, siamtak a kigan puanduang kawnggak in amah na gak ding ahi.
english: You shall take the garments, and put on Aaron the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod, and the breastplate, and clothe him with the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

paite: Alutung ah lukhu na koih dia, lukhu tung ah lallukhu siangthou na koih ding ahi.
english: You shall set the turban on his head, and put the holy crown on the turban.

paite: Thau nilhchi na la dia, alutung ah na buak dia amah na nuh ding ahi.
english: Then you shall take the anointing oil, and pour it on his head, and anoint him.

paite: Atapate na hon pi dia puanak tungte na silhsak ding ahi.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

paite: Kawnggak in amau na gak dia, Aaron leh atapate, lukhu bem na khusak ding hi. Omden ding dan thuseh a ding in siampu nasep amaute a ahi ding. Hichibang in Aaron leh atapate na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: You shall clothe them with belts, Aaron and his sons, and bind headbands on them. They shall have the priesthood by a perpetual statute. You shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin ma ah bawngtal na kaisak dia; Aaron leh atapate'n bawngtal lutung ah akhutte uh anga ding uhi.
english: “You shall bring the bull before the Tent of Meeting; and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak kiang ah, TOUPA ma ah bawngtal na gou ding ahi.
english: You shall kill the bull before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Bawngtal sisan na la dia, na khutzung in maitam kiite na nuh dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul sik ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
english: You shall take of the blood of the bull, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger; and you shall pour out all the blood at the base of the altar.

paite: Asunglam tuamtu athau tengteng na la dia, asin tung a alam omleh, akailing nihte leh atung ua athau maitam tung ah na hal ding hi.
english: You shall take all the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

paite: Bawngtal sa leh avun leh a-ek, giahphual polam ah mei in na hal ding hi. Hiai khelhna thillat ahi.
english: But the meat of the bull, and its skin, and its dung, you shall burn with fire outside of the camp. It is a sin offering.

paite: Belampa khat na la dia, belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh anga ding uhi.
english: “You shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Belampa na that ding a, asisan na la dia, maitam kimvel in na theh ding hi.
english: You shall kill the ram, and you shall take its blood, and sprinkle it around on the altar.

paite: Belampa na semnen dia, asunglam na sawpsiang dia, akhete leh asate leh alu na koihkhawm ding hi.
english: You shall cut the ram into its pieces, and wash its innards, and its legs, and put them with its pieces, and with its head.

paite: Belampa avek in maitam tung ah na halmang ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
english: You shall burn the whole ram on the altar: it is a burnt offering to Yahweh; it is a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Belampa dang na la dia; belampa lutung ah Aaron leh atapate'n akhut uh akoih ding uhi.
english: “You shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Huan huai belampa na gou dia, Aaron bil taklam dawn leh atapate bil taklam dawn ah leh akhut taklam khutpi uah, akhe taklam khepi uah, asisan na la dia, na nuh ding a, maitam kimvel ah huai sisan na theh ding ahi.
english: Then you shall kill the ram, and take some of its blood, and put it on the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and on the tip of the right ear of his sons, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

paite: Maitam tung a om sisan na la ding a, nuh theih thau toh, Aaron tung ah leh apuan tung ah leh atapate tung ah leh akiang a atapate puan tung ah na theh ding hi. Huchi in amah leh apuante leh tapate leh atapate' puante hihsiangthou ahi ding hi.
english: You shall take of the blood that is on the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron, and on his garments, and on his sons, and on the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be made holy, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

paite: Huai Belampa thaute, amei thau, asung thau, asin leh akailing nihte leh athaute, ataklam phei toh na la ding ahi; hiai bel siangthou a sehtuamna belampa ahih ziak ahi.
english: Also you shall take some of the ram’s fat, the fat tail, the fat that covers the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys, the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

paite: TOUPA mai a lohbeu a om silngou soh louh tanghou kikoihte lak a tanghou beu khat, sathau a kikang tanghou pei khat leh tanghou kan pek khat na la dia,
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

paite: Aaron khut leh atapate khut ah na koih dia; huaite TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi.
english: You shall put all of this in Aaron’s hands, and in his sons’ hands, and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Amau khut a pan huaite na sang dia, halmang thillat ding in maitam tung ah na hal ding ahi, TOUPA ma a gimlim hi ding in. Hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Aaron hihsianthouna belampa awm na la dia, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in na vei ding hi. Hiai nang tan ding ahi.
english: “You shall take the breast of Aaron’s ram of consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be your portion.

paite: Huai siangthou a sehtuamna belampa a pan vei thillat a veisa a-awm leh vei thillat a veisa aphei, Aaron tan leh atapate tante na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: You shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the wave offering, which is waved, and which is raised up, of the ram of consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons.

paite: Hiai Israel suante a pan a dan thuseh bang a Aaron leh atapate tan ngeina ahih gige ding ahi. Huai bel Israel suante'n alemna thillatte ua pan TOUPA a dia apiak ding uh ahi.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel; for it is a wave offering. It shall be a wave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, even their wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Aaron puansilh siangthoute amah nung in atapate a ahi ding uh; amaute a hihsiangthou ding leh sehkip ding in.
english: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.

paite: Ama mun a siampu hong hi atapa in Mun Siangthou a nasem dia kihoupihna biakbuk sung a alut chiang in, ni sagih sung huai puansilhte asilh ding ahi.
english: Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in the holy place.

paite: Kihihsianthouna belampa na la dia, mun siangthou ah asa na tuihuan ding ahi.
english: “You shall take the ram of consecration and boil its meat in a holy place.

paite: Aaron leh atapate'n belampa sa leh loh sung a om kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak kiang ah tanghou ane ding uhi.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the meat of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Amau sehkipna ding leh hihsianthouna dia akhelhna thoihna thilte anek ding uh ahi. Thilzek leh siangthou ahih ziak in midang kuamah in anek louh ding uh ahi.
english: They shall eat those things with which atonement was made, to consecrate and sanctify them; but a stranger shall not eat of it, because they are holy.

paite: Kihihsianthouna sa hiam tanghou hiam zingsang tan a-omleh mei in na hal ding ahi. Asianthou ziak in na ne ding ahi kei.
english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

paite: Huchibang a thu ka hon piak bangbang in Aaron kiang ah leh atapate kiang ah na hih dia, ni sagih sung amau na hihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.

paite: Lemna thillat ding in niteng in bawngtal khat khelhna thillat ding in na lan ding ahi. Hiai a dia lemna na bawlzoh chiang in, maitam na hihsiang dia, thau na nilh dia, na siangthousak ding ahi,
english: Every day you shall offer the bull of sin offering for atonement. You shall cleanse the altar when you make atonement for it. You shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

paite: Ni sagih sung maitam a ding in lemna na bawl dia; na hihsiangthou dia; maitam siangthoupen ahi ding. Huai maitam khoih peuhmah a sianthou ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.

paite: Niteng a maitam tung ah kum khat a upa belamnou nih na lat gige ding ahi.
heading: Niteng Thillat / (Nam 28.1-8)
english: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan dia; belamnou dang khat nitaklam in na lan ding ahi.
english: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at evening;

paite: Belamnou khat na lat chiang in tangbuang seh sawm suah seh khat, athau toh hin khat a seh lina toh dawn thillat ding in uain hin khat a seh lina na lan ding ahi.
english: and with the one lamb a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil, and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

paite: Belamnou khat dang pen nitaklam in na lan dia, tangbuang thillat dungzui in leh dawn thillat dungzui in gimlim ding in, na hih dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat gimnamtui ahi.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening, and shall do to it according to the meal offering of the morning and according to its drink offering, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Na khang na khang un hiai TOUPA ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a halmang thillat ahi nilouh ding ahi. Huai ah na kiang ua thu gen ding in ka hon kituahpih ding hi.
english: It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh, where I will meet with you, to speak there to you.

paite: Huai ah Israel suante ka kituahpih dia, ka thupina in biakbuk ahihsiangthou ding hi.
english: There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin leh maitam ka hihsiangthou dia; siampu a pang a kei a dia nasem ding in Aaron leh atapate leng ka hihsiangthou tuaktuak ding hi.
english: I will sanctify the Tent of Meeting and the altar. I will also sanctify Aaron and his sons to minister to me in the priest’s office.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante lak ah ka teng dia, a Pathian uh ka hi ding.
english: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh, alak ua ka tentheihna dia amaute Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa ka hi, chih athei ding uh. TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi.
english: They shall know that I am Yahweh their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, that I might dwell among them: I am Yahweh their God.
